name: douyin-video-download
doc: resolve one item's watermark-free play address. Evidence: /aweme/v1/web/aweme/detail/ (docs 7.2.1) + service.douyin.video_download_process/finished (service.* table). The play URL is extracted from aweme_detail.video.play_addr.url_list; the download itself is a plain HTTP GET.

cookie.source: browser profile import or env MEDIAMON_DOUYIN_COOKIES
